en: An archerfish grown to a dog's length in the fen's tea-dark water. It knocks beetles off the roots with a jet of water, and lately it has started aiming higher.
A tree-crab of the mangroves, bark-brown and spotted with lichen. It lives in the prop-roots and drags what it catches into them to eat later.
A leech as flat and long as a ribbon, its underside faintly amber. The Kirru wade the channels with their legs wrapped, and still come home bitten.

From the bank it is a dead tree standing in the channel. Its roots reach down into the black water and keep what they catch, and some of what they keep is light. Three of Reedhollow's clutch went into the water near it at the full moon.
Find what is drowning the fen.
At dusk, go down to the shore. Stand at the back.
Pell is waiting outside the gate.
A widow's net is still in the dead channel.
Roots hold whoever they catch. A rooted hero can't be swapped out until they break free.
The leeches heal on what they take. Strike them before they feed.
Listen, and Pell learns what he hears. It costs him this turn.
Each root holding it shows on the timeline. Break them and it comes loose.
Mangrove bark that stains everything it touches the colour of strong tea. Used in Customize.
A Kirru salve of pounded reed-root, cool on the skin. Kirru children are made to carry it, and do.
Mangrove hardwood shafts with salvage points, bound Kirru-fashion in reed cord. They don't slip when wet.
A reed lodge raised on roots over the lagoon, kept for guests. The walls breathe. All night the clutch whistles softly from lodge to lodge.
